documents.text: Hughesville, Missouri Hughesville is a village in Pettis County, Missouri, United States. The population was 183 at the 2010 census. Hughesville was platted in 1871 by Reece Hughes, who gave the town his last name. A post office called Hughesville has been in operation since 1872. The Osage Farms Resettlement Properties in Pettis County, Missouri includes properties listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1991. The Gen. David Thomson House was listed in 1982.
